alternatives_rejected.why: CPU is elevated but ranks below memory in E1 (z=292 vs z=408). Memory exhaustion can drive CPU up through GC and allocation pressure, but a CPU hog would not explain a 20x jump in memory (E1).

E1's ranking across all services contains only checkoutservice metrics. E2 shows checkoutservice's caller-observed latency rising 20x with zero errors. E3 shows payments still going through, so there is no sign of a failing downstream.

proposed_fix.description: Do a rolling restart of the checkoutservice pods to reclaim leaked memory, adding replicas first to keep capacity. Raise the memory limit temporarily, then capture a heap profile to find and fix the leak (or roll back the latest checkoutservice release).
